List available bundles for a dataset

Source: R/utils.R
available_bundles.Rd

Returns the full names of all white-matter bundles available in the specified dataset. The returned names are the values to supply to the bundle argument of import_bundle().

Usage

available_bundles(dataset)

Arguments

dataset

A string naming the dataset. Must be one of the values returned by available_datasets().

Value

A character vector of bundle names.

Examples

available_bundles("HCP1065")
#>  [1] "Anterior Commissure"                       
#>  [2] "Left Arcuate Fasciculus"                   
#>  [3] "Right Arcuate Fasciculus"                  
#>  [4] "Left Acoustic Radiation"
